bio: Spice markets and street-food stalls across India. Steam, sizzle, colour — and the cook who has done this for forty years.
avatar: Portrait of a man in his mid 30s with a warm smile and a short beard wearing a mustard shirt in a colourful market, shoulders-up, photographic, fictional person
banner: Ultra-wide panoramic photograph of a colourful spice market with pyramids of red yellow and orange spices and warm sunlight, subject across the middle band, cinematic

collections.title: Streets & stalls
collections.description: India, one plate at a time.
videos: Spice pyramids at the morning market

videos.title: Spice pyramids at the morning market
videos.description: Turmeric, chilli and cumin heaped in perfect cones.
videos.still: Wide photograph of an Indian spice market stall with conical heaps of turmeric, red chilli and cumin in baskets, morning sunbeams, a vendor seen from behind, no text
videos.motion: Sunbeams shift across the spice piles, a faint haze of spice dust drifts, gentle slow camera pan.

videos.title: Dosa on the hot griddle
videos.description: A thin batter spread in one circle, then folded.
videos.still: Vertical photograph of a cook's hands spreading thin dosa batter on a large hot griddle with steam rising, warm light, no face, no text
videos.motion: Steam rises as the batter spreads in a spiral and turns golden, slow top-down drift.

videos.title: Chai for the whole street
videos.description: A tall pour of tea from one pot to another.
videos.still: Vertical photograph of a street vendor pouring steaming milky chai in a long arc between two metal vessels, steam, blurred street behind, face turned away, no text
videos.motion: The chai pours in a long steady arc, steam swirls, the street bustles blurred behind, slow camera follow.

videos.title: Tandoor flatbreads
videos.description: Dough slapped against the clay wall, ready in a minute.
videos.still: Wide photograph of a baker slapping dough onto the inside wall of a clay tandoor oven with glowing coals, orange flames and bread blistering, hands only, no face, no text
videos.motion: Flames flicker and the flatbread puffs and blisters, steam and sparks drift, slow camera push-in.

stories.still: Vertical photograph of whole spices ground in a stone mortar with a pestle, warm light, no people, no text

stories.still: Vertical photograph of red chillies drying in strings against a sunny wall, no people, no text
